subject: general
question: ______ is a type of malware that is often disguised as legitimate software.
solution:
Trojan is malicious programs that are often disguised as legitimate software.

Computer viruses are unwanted software programs or pieces of code that interfere with the functioning of the computer. They are self-replicating computer program that interferes with the functioning of the computer by infecting files, data, programs, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Trojan Horse 

 
• A Trojan is sometimes called a Trojan virus or a Trojan horse virus, but that’s a misnomer.
 
• Viruses can execute and replicate themselves but Trojan cannot.
 
• A user has to execute Trojans. 
 
• It can't replicate like viruses and worms as a Trojan horse hides in a program.
 
• it is a type of malicious code or software that looks legitimate and acts as a bona fide application or file Once installed, Once you install any such program, the trojan horse enters your computer.
 
• It can provide unauthorized access to your computer, send your files to other computers, and may delete files or can make other unwanted changes in your computer by gathering information by monitoring.

**Trojan malware example to show how it works.**

 
• You might think you’ve received an email from someone you know and click on what looks like a legitimate attachment. But you’ve been fooled. The email is from a cybercriminal, and the file you clicked on — and downloaded and opened — has gone on to install malware on your device.
 
• When you execute the program, the malware can spread to other files and damage your computer
